evidence_quote: Credit expiry & extension operations give admins a customer-level view of all wallet balances and their expiry dates, to manage upcoming expiries.

requirement: The system shall provide a configuration simulation/test mode letting an admin validate a wallet configuration by running sample transactions before publishing it live.

requirement: A parent's wallet shall be able to fund linked child wristbands/wallets without the child needing a separate top-up.

requirement: The parent shall be able to configure per-child spending allowances against the family balance.
evidence_quote: the parent can configure per-child spending allowances (e.g., of a AED 500 family balance, one child is capped at AED 200 and another at AED 200).

requirement: Guests shall be able to create family-member profiles themselves and configure spending limits directly from their own guest account, in addition to venue-side configuration.
evidence_quote: Confirmed: guests can create family-member profiles themselves and configure spending limits directly from their own guest account, in addition to venue-side configuration.

requirement: Family permission rules shall restrict top-up of the family wallet to the parent/guardian, with children able to view balances and transactions and spend, unless permissions are explicitly reconfigured.
evidence_quote: Family permission rules: a parent/guardian is typically the only member allowed to top up the family wallet; children can view balances and transactions and spend, but cannot top up, unless permissions are explicitly reconfigured.

requirement: Corporate/group wallets shall allow funds to be loaded and segregated across departments such as marketing and operations.
evidence_quote: Corporate/group wallets: funds can be loaded and segregated across departments (e.g., marketing, operations) for corporate/company accounts.

requirement: Balance shall be movable between linked wallets in either direction within a family or group structure, as a configurable venue-controlled feature rather than always enabled.
evidence_quote: Shared wallet transfer: balance can be moved between linked wallets in either direction (parent → child or child → parent) within a family or group structure — confirmed as a configurable, venue-controlled feature rather than always enabled.

requirement: The system shall support a monetary gift card redeemable as general value against any product or service the venue offers.
evidence_quote: Gift cards and vouchers follow similar mechanics to the wallet, with two variants: a monetary gift card (redeemable as general value against any product/service the venue offers)

requirement: The system shall support a product-specific gift voucher redeemable only against a named product or experience and not exchangeable for value against other products.
evidence_quote: and a product-specific gift voucher (an entitlement redeemable only against a named product/experience, e.g., a dolphin-show voucher, not exchangeable for value against other products).

requirement: The system shall configure whether a gift card or voucher can be redeemed online, on-site, or both.
evidence_quote: Redemption channel configuration determines whether a gift card/voucher can be redeemed online, on-site, or both.

requirement: Wallet spend shall be reportable by department/category such as F&B, attractions, retail and partners.
evidence_quote: Wallet payments: spend can be reported by department/category (F&B, attractions, retail, partners) and by channel (B2C, POS)

requirement: Wallet spend shall be reportable by channel such as B2C and POS.
evidence_quote: spend can be reported by department/category (F&B, attractions, retail, partners) and by channel (B2C, POS)

requirement: The system shall support a wallet payment/redemption policy defining rules such as a minimum spend to use the wallet as a payment method.
evidence_quote: wallet payment/redemption policy defines rules such as minimum spend to use wallet as a payment method.

requirement: The system shall associate a wallet with its supporting media - RFID/wristband, QR code or other identifiers - for use across channels.
evidence_quote: Wallet-to-media linking associates a wallet with its supporting media — RFID/wristband, QR code, or other identifiers — for use across channels.

requirement: A guest shall be able to redeem/unload a remaining wallet balance at end of visit, for example at a counter after a balance check.
evidence_quote: Unload/refund: a guest can redeem/unload a remaining wallet balance at end of visit (e.g., at a counter, after a balance check) rather than keeping it loaded.

requirement: The system shall support peer-to-peer transfer of balance from one guest's wallet directly to another guest's wallet.
evidence_quote: Peer-to-peer transfer: supports transferring balance from one guest's wallet directly to another guest's wallet.

requirement: Peer-to-peer transfer and end-of-visit balance unload/refund shall each be a configurable venue-level toggle rather than a default always-on feature.
evidence_quote: Chinmay confirmed this, like the unload/refund flow, should be a configurable, venue-level toggle (allowed or not allowed) rather than a default always-on feature — agreed by Allam.

requirement: The system shall provide wallet risk policy configuration bundling validity, expiry and refund rules per wallet policy.
evidence_quote: Wallet risk policy configuration bundles validity, expiry and refund rules per wallet policy.

requirement: The system shall assign a risk score to transactions to flag potentially fraudulent or suspicious activity.
evidence_quote: Transaction risk scoring engine: assigns a risk score to transactions to flag potentially fraudulent or suspicious activity.

requirement: Transactions flagged as high risk shall be routed to the operations team for manual cross-verification rather than being auto-approved or auto-declined.
evidence_quote: Allam confirmed flagged transactions are routed to the operations team for manual cross-verification rather than being auto-approved or auto-declined by the system.

requirement: The system shall support lost-media recovery, letting the operations team identify the guest, locate the original transaction and transfer the balance to a replacement wristband or card.
evidence_quote: Lost-media recovery: if a guest loses a wristband/card with a loaded balance, the operations team can identify the guest (e.g., via phone number or ID), locate the original transaction, and transfer the balance to a replacement wristband/card.

requirement: Finance shall be able to report total outstanding wallet liability, revenue recognized and related balances at any time.
evidence_quote: every wallet transaction ties back to the chart of accounts, so finance can report total outstanding liability, revenue recognized, and related balances at any time.

requirement: The wallet API shall allow external systems to check a wallet balance and process a transaction, with the wallet balance updated in the system afterward.
evidence_quote: Wallet APIs support two integration patterns: (1) external systems consuming TICVAI's wallet API directly to check balance and process a transaction, with the wallet balance updated in the system afterward

requirement: The wallet API shall integrate with a third-party F&B/retail POS system such as Micros or Symphony so that it can verify sufficient balance, process a transaction and reduce the balance on completion.
evidence_quote: and (2) integration with a third-party F&B/retail POS system (e.g., Micros, Symphony) at a venue, where the third-party system consumes the wallet API to verify sufficient balance and process a transaction, with the balance reduced accordingly on completion.

requirement: The B2C ticketing website flow shall cover product creation and add-to-cart, and is being revised before sharing.
evidence_quote: Chinmay confirmed the B2C ticketing website flow (product creation and add-to-cart) referenced in a prior session is still being revised, led by Aishwarya, and will be shared once finalized.

requirement: Three separate wireframe flows shall be prepared for general ticketing, F&B and retail and reviewed ahead of full UI/UX build so structural issues can be corrected early.
evidence_quote: Planned: Chinmay and Pradnya will prepare three separate wireframe flows — general ticketing, F&B, and retail — to be shared for review ahead of full UI/UX build, so that any structural issues can be corrected early.
